insights: ✅ Mālama (care/stewardship) is strongly positive — use land-based activities to reinforce cultural connection

narrative.summary: The cohort mean for ʻIke Kūpuna is 71.3. 36.5% of students are Proficient or Advanced. 33 students require targeted cultural support. Hawaiian Language programme shows a +12.0 pt effect; Hālau Hula shows a +6.7 pt effect.
